prior_release_validation.scope: Publication integrity and selected independent replays. Archived Lean build/audit evidence retained; this release validation does not newly compile every historical source or prove decimal Lychrel existence.

scope: Cumulative historical validation records plus completed renewal source integrity and audit consistency; exact evidence levels remain attached to each checkpoint. No main existence proof.

coordination_checkpoint.scope: Publication policy and active-session coordination only; final renewal research awaits its later audit-ready signal.
coordination_checkpoint.concurrent_commit_scope: Adds only contributions/COORDINATION.md with proposals and verification scope; no completed theorem or replay command

early_renewal_tail_checkpoint.checked_from: exact copy of staged tails sources and certificate
early_renewal_tail_checkpoint.scope: Written all-parameter tail proofs and independent replay; complete finite census with UNKNOWN results retained; no new Lean result or main-existence proof claimed

checked_contributions.scope: Checked standalone safe-prefix, gate-lifetime and finite-horizon-density additions. Historical research preserved. No main existence proof.

early_formal_gate_checkpoint.build_evidence: Retained complete fresh source rebuild and root independent gate recompilation; publication checks their exact source hashes, dependency presence, theorem coverage and log/audit consistency
early_formal_gate_checkpoint.scope: All-r two-step gate for p=1..4 and original six-core Domain; no recurrent certificate, main-existence proof or 196 result
early_formal_gate_checkpoint.concurrent_review_scope: Incoming 24-declaration support bundle and written separation/density/lifetime reports preserved, with their own audit records. Publication verifies integration bytes and documentation; independent mathematical review is a separate active workstream.

completed_renewal_checkpoint.scope: Exact source identity, recorded audit consistency, source/dependency presence, compressed archive readability and release links; no new compiler, capped search or external full-trace replay
